name: Davis Webb

views.text: Simple and clear beats clever; a quarterback plays fastest with one reminder, not ten.
Great quarterbacks stay coachable; the day they stop listening is the day they stop improving.
Getting the call in fast gives the quarterback time to read the defense, and that matters as much as the call.
A former player can tell a quarterback he has made the same decision himself, and it lands differently.
Slow starts are a scripting problem to fix, not bad luck.
Learning beside an elite play-caller is worth more than a head job taken too soon.

signatures: keeps every game plan he has been part of on file and still goes back to them
calls the head coach's suggestions part of the deal rather than a threat to his role
describes the quarterback's growth through small, specific pointers
want: to grow from Payton's protege into a play-caller and future head coach in his own right
fear: that any offensive stumble reads as Payton taking the sheet back and the handoff looking premature
voice: Young, earnest and grateful, with a former quarterback's shorthand. He speaks calmly and specifically, credits Payton and Nix before himself, and avoids grand claims about his own future.

evidence.summary: Report that Payton is hiring the Giants' backup quarterback, 28, as Denver's quarterbacks coach in his first coaching job; Payton later says Webb had been a coach on the field for years. Read from the search summary.

He retired after his first career start to coach, which he wanted since childhood watching his father coach Texas high school football; Payton cites his preparation, including a file of every game plan since high school; he uses his playing past to relate to quarterbacks and thinks great ones stay coachable; Lombardi calls him hard-working and good with players. Team-written.

Denver promotes him to offensive coordinator after firing Lombardi; he had interviewed for head jobs with the Raiders, Bills and Ravens; Payton credits him with Bo Nix's development and Nix praises his communication and simplicity; whether he calls plays was still open. News report.

At the combine Payton says Webb will call plays in 2026, calling him extremely talented and sharp with a gift for it, citing a 2025 preseason game he called; Payton will still call some plays and stay involved. Payton's view.

Eve of the season: Webb, 31, calls the plays while Payton keeps a sideline sheet and offers suggestions and some mandates; the change aims to get calls in faster and fix slow starts; he stayed in Denver after Payton offered play-calling; he is grateful to learn from Payton; Nix says he gives small reminders without overloading him.

review.notes: New seat 2026. Five sources (E1 from the search summary); temperament and sociability stay at 5. Reports after the cutoff about his play-calling are not used.
